description: Repair needed: pull-sync converged goal-host-vessel to 17f2e415da with NO test gate — the per-tick budget (420s) was exhausted after 781s, so the suite never ran. This is not a passing gate, it is an absent one, and it is absent precisely when a tick is slow, which is when convergence is riskiest.
